Get completions for given action from given command.

Usage: linear completions complete [OPTIONS] <action> [command]... [-- <literal>...]

Arguments:
  <action>      
  [command]...  
  [literal]...  Literal words from saved scripts are not command-path words

Options:
      --workspace <slug>  Target workspace (uses credentials)
  -h, --help              Print help
